cards.title: Universal compensation needs nonlocal nonlinear selection; strict heat certificates supply critical-trace storage
cards.scientific_scope: Smooth finite jets give exactly determinant-affine support; no universal coefficient-linear selector exists even with arbitrary nonlocal profiles. A supplied strict QC margin gives full strong-critical Lipschitz storage. Full invariant cone and historical novelty remain UNKNOWN.
cards.statement: For all smooth periodic U,V and a smooth finite-jet density, differential domination at B exists iff F has a determinant-affine support at B. On V9 no finite-valued coefficient-linear selector dominates all rank-one-convex energies. If F-epsilon|A|^4 is independently QC, W1,4 incoming-action storage is finite and locally Lipschitz at all B. Fstar entry action -7/120 proves weak-critical and finite-measurement limits.
assumptions: Unconstrained smooth periodic profile means and all smooth velocities; density globally smooth on a fixed finite jet space.
No-linear selection is universal over the full invariant cone, finite valued, with arbitrary positive strip durations.
Positive critical-storage theorem requires independently established strict quasiconvexity; the N794 Fstar premise remains internally derived and externally unreviewed.
proof_spine: Uniform Euler L1 bound, high-jet oscillations and total-derivative order descent.
Translation-orbit averaging; even slow tilts and odd cubic degeneration contradict a negative open strip.
Strict bulk gluing and bounded critical trace extension control all incoming durations; exact oriented concentration blocks weak/Fourier closure.
cards.costs: Analytic existence, not a finite representation or certified evaluation algorithm. Tail acquisition, coefficient precision and infinite-dimensional variational optimization remain paid/UNKNOWN.
cards.information_acquisition: Exact polynomial coefficients and existing strict heat certificate are supplied. A critical tail or stronger regularity budget is needed for controlled Fourier approximation.
cards.obstruction: The incoming required-supply infimum cannot prove unknown QC without an independent lower bound; finite smooth jets and universal coefficient-linear selectors are refuted certificate classes.
cards.comparator: Classical null-Lagrangian/storage machinery and Bruno-Pasqualotto heat/exact-form method are prior art; OpenAI Math tree/Gram proofs lack the needed compatible profile representation.
cards.missing_lemma: A constructive nonlinearly coefficient-dependent critical storage or incoming-action lower bound for the still-uncertified acoustic cone.
cards.next_decisive_step: Prove that nonlinear critical-profile bound without assuming QC, or construct an exact negative compatible closed cycle with a certified acoustic-cone integrand.
cards.read_review_depth: Root reconstructed the selected proofs and strict heat conversion; independent same-team adversarial reconstruction found no remaining decisive gap. Finite symbolic checks are separate; external correctness and priority UNKNOWN.

depends_on.scope: Only the Fstar positive critical-storage application imports the strict N794 heat margin; the general no-go theorems do not.
depends_on.relation_status: PROVEN LOGICAL DEPENDENCY under inherited internal proof status

cards.title: Task-matched conditional exchange with exact copy costs and correlation-sensitive certification limits
cards.scientific_scope: Coarse matching and paid scalar-channel Lipschitz pairing avoid exact-record sparsity conditionally. Exact global outputs require N>=2m; local outputs retain cross correlations. Hidden bath swap and reference-only score controls limit acquisition and interpretation. No hardware or advantage established.
cards.statement: For even N and a uniform paid half-diamond bound L|t-tprime| on selected continuations over range R, adjacent sorted pairing gives mean tagged bias <=2LR/N. Universal exact jointly independent product-marginal outputs require N>=2m for nontrivial registers, including nonzero heralding. Pair/triple local scoring admits radius sqrt(6 log(8/delta)/(BN)) under its stronger independence/locality contract.
assumptions: Independent joint preparations conditional on all observed labels, or an explicitly selection-stable cross-independence contract for the mean.
Uniform acquired task-channel equivalence/Lipschitz bound, matched site continuations, donor record/reference tracking and a physical operation certificate on native correlations.
Exact copy no-go assumes fixed worst-case budget and parameter-independent quantum instrument/ancillas with dim data,environment>=2. Approximate finite-difference bound is deterministic CPTP only.
proof_spine: Condition on all labels; independent recipient environment gives exact coarse mixture and adjacent-pair diamond bound.
Retained-factor partial trace and input polynomial degree establish global correlation and exact copy costs.
Independent pair/triple components plus random-label Lipschitz3/N give concentration; hidden bath swap and blank-S/Bell-RE are exact falsifiers.
cards.costs: All histories, independent whole-module preparation, rejected modules, reference storage/readout, matching, local instruments, channel/frame calibration, routing losses, reset and switching work are charged. No dimension-independent total advantage.
cards.information_acquisition: A paid sufficient coarse record or uniform channel geometry is required. Reduced gate tomography, unchanged bath marginals and reset-only probes do not certify native-correlation routing.
cards.obstruction: The missing operation is correlation-safe routing, not merely a reduced SWAP. Tagged reference reassignment can cause the whole contrast with zero physical state change. Local decorrelation is not global erasure.
cards.comparator: Two-copy recombination, conditional erasure, targeted response matrices and known wire cutting (qubit bounded-score multiplier9) already exist; direct randomized trials answer executable policy rankings.
cards.missing_lemma: An experimentally justified joint/router locality certificate and a held-out decision advantage over equally informed targeted measurements or virtual score estimation.
cards.next_decisive_step: Use independently auditable controlled baths with native correlated calibration inputs, deliberate hidden bath swap/flip and reference-pairing controls; acquire task-channel bounds and compare complete costs on a held-out logical workload.
cards.read_review_depth: Incoming identity reconstructed; root derived retained-workload and random-label steps; separate same-team proof review and finite checks recorded. Frozen deterministic/approximate scope correction preserved. No physical validation.

cards.title: Polarity-conjugate optical and electromechanical drives require coupled same-regime retained-output qualification
cards.scientific_scope: Conditional spatial-overlap, static-phase, self-actuation and rooted-boundary constraints sharpen a physical proposal. Independent field/shear is a model alternative with paid joint losses. Hot material response, legal atomic pathway, retention and superiority remain unacquired.
cards.statement: Prescribed two-color rigid-wall pressure has tangent sinc factors and cos(Phi+qnormal X); static normal mismatch gives zero work per beat. Self-generated harmonic force and stress-free piezoelectric self-actuation are inversion-even. Independent shear restores p=2dE sigma; a measured joint damping form bounds its loss. Fixed mixed-polarity interface trace prevents entire-stack purification by interior motion alone.
assumptions: Actual domain pair is independently verified inversion-related; tensor contraction and true internal fields/modes are nonzero and calibrated.
Optical overlap/force uses the stated prescribed or calibrated Hermitian-mode model; static wall examples assume their explicit free/pinned geometry.
Electrical loss inequalities use the stated measured damping or uniform Ohmic regime, not arbitrary depletion; hot coefficients and directional mobility are UNKNOWN.
proof_spine: Virtual-work surface integral gives sinc overlap and static periodic potential; optical inversion covariance gives no-seed null.
Electric enthalpy minimization gives finite-stiffness/self-actuation null; AM-GM/Cauchy-Schwarz couple pressure and paid damping.
Fixed boundary trace and exact elastica distinguish bowing/upper-layer cleanup from whole-stack erasure; primary hot-gap and comparator scopes are retained.
cards.costs: Acquire coupling, hot absorption/carriers, true force overlap, stiffness/pinning/mobility, contacts/depletion, independent stress and full source/thermal/readout/yield costs in one specimen/regime. Static DFT and cold coefficients are normalizations, not hot performance.
cards.information_acquisition: No common operating window is supplied. Same-regime signed structural trajectories and post-drive 3D retained atomic/function endpoint are required; optical contrast or reduced surface count is insufficient.
cards.obstruction: Static mismatch may cancel/drift-lock, roots may remain, self-induced controls lack an independent polarity reference, and nonlinear/mixed absorption can defeat pressure. Thin400nm cold overlap is not rejected.
cards.comparator: Optimized capped dark annealing and epitaxial/template growth; Alcotte comparator is APB-free upper region with defective basal region. Match endpoint including/excluding interface and complete accepted-output costs.
cards.missing_lemma: A measured common regime in which adequate signed bias and a legal mobile pathway complete a retained useful transformation at competitive full cost.
cards.next_decisive_step: Qualify one mapped nearly planar boundary with an exit, calibrated independent conjugate controls and matched heat/carriers; demand sign-reversed retained 3D polarity/function and full cost versus annealing/growth.
cards.read_review_depth: Root read derivations and primary-source receipts; workers reconstructed and checked conditional algebra/normalizations. No hot material experiment, independently validated mechanism or historical priority.

notices.clarification: FQ finite-jet and linear-selection no-go theorems do not refute N819 one-frequency storage. N794 strict heat margin supplies a strong-critical full-profile value for the certified energy, but evaluation and unknown-cone QC remain open. Fstar negative open entries are compatible with its positive closed Jensen theorem.

notices.clarification: Hidden SWAP_E passes bath marginals, every reset-input probe and accessible gate/roundtrip tests yet defeats the intended exchange. Blank-S/Bell-RE gives a reference-only contrast. A finite-collar joint residual bridge remains conditional on full joint access/reset/model-error premises; no inherited gate is closed.

notices.issue: Frozen report finite-error finite-difference paragraph has deterministic-output scope.
notices.clarification: The approximate finite-difference lower bound is proved only for deterministic CPTP output probabilities. Normalized heralded probabilities can be rational. Exact universal heralded N>=2m remains valid. The frozen original and separate correction are both retained.

notices.issue: Cold optical/piezoelectric ingredients do not qualify a hot retained structural operation.
notices.clarification: FQ adds seeded reactive force/overlap and independent electric-shear models without importing N821 dissipative carrier coefficients as conservative force. Root/interface, hot mixed absorption, independent-port nulls and matched accepted endpoint remain gates. The thin400nm overlap example is not excluded; static DFT stiffness is only a normalization.
